body: Since `get_path_to` is expensive without cache, I think we should complete its construction outside the `for` loop, just as in the original structure of this code, it is why #120403 adds `r_folded_group_renames`.
So, the change you probably need to make in this PR is these lines, instead of deleting these.
What would be the cost of doing this every time of calling _set_animation_folds? Ideally, iterating through everything the moment the project is opened.
